fullContentHtml:
RSSB LDC Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Assistant Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Admit Card for the recruitment of Clerk Gr-II/ Junior posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 10,644 posts. Applications for the RSSB Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 15, 2026, to February 13, 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 05 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RSSB Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 January 2026
  • Last Date : 13 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 February 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 16 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 05 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 26 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 01 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EBC , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

RSSB LDC Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Assistant Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 13 February 2026.

The official website is: https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
